scenes.text: Imagine standing in a massive, beautiful forest in Yellowstone National Park while knowing that you could technically commit a serious crime here and walk away completely free.
This terrifying loophole is one hundred percent real because the US Constitution strictly guarantees you a trial by a jury selected from the exact state and district where the crime occurred.
Here is the catch: this specific uninhabited sliver of the park sits inside Idaho, but the entire park is under the federal jurisdiction of Wyoming, requiring local jury members who do not exist.
Since the official population in this zone is exactly zero, a legal trial can never actually happen, so would you ever camp in this lawless area? Comment your thoughts and follow for more!
